notes.title: Minor updates & bug fixes
notes.notes:
This update includes numerous balance adjustments and bug fixes, making the demo experience more stable.
[p align="start"]Here are the patch notes:
[olist]
Reworked the Imperial Chef's skills and reintroduced them to the demo content.

Reworked "Signature Light Meal". Its new effect is: Each non-vegetarian item on the menu increases the selling price of vegetarian orders by 5%.

Reworked "Catered Work Meals". Its new effect is: Customers' dining time is reduced by 60%.

Reworked "Guild Organization". Its new effect is: Each employee increases daily guild coin income by 10.

Buffed "Financial Training". It now also grants 10% interest on guild coins.

Buffed "All-Drinks Trend". Its selling price has been increased from 500 to 1000.

Buffed "Veteran Bartender". The multiplier for number of crafts has been increased from x2 to x3.

Nerfed "Fingertip Grace". The sachet's multiplier has been reduced from x5 to x3, and the bonus from Skill 3 has been reduced from 100% to 50%.

Nerfed "The Mimic". The Mimic's selling price bonus from wages is halved, and the wage cap has been increased from 10,000 to 100,000.

Increased the trigger chance for Glutton's Skill 3.

Increased the selling price of Spiral-Shark Meat Soup.

Adjusted Duke Severin's initial drink menu.

Changed the effect of "Magic Firework Launcher+" from "No cap on Popularity" to "Increases Popularity cap by 1000".

Fixed incorrect displayed values and buffs for the drink menu.

Fixed an error causing the Down-and-Out Nobleman to fail when brewing.

Fixed an issue where empty orders would appear when there was nothing to make.

Adjusted the notification text for creating perfect or flawed dishes.

Fixed incorrect text display for the Spice Master, Wandering Chef, etc.

Fixed an issue where the "Perfect Pairing" effect could persist until the next day.

Fixed an issue where the Apostle of Lamo's Emissary skill effect could persist until the next day.

Fixed an issue where participating in an assessment could complete the "Forced Consumption" task.

Optimized the UI for ingredient selection in "Distant Dream" and for using tavern flyer-type items.

Reworked the Westgreen traveler's first skill. Its new effect is: Each day, there is a chance to increase an actor's charisma by 1 point or a bartender's skill by 1 point.

Fixed an issue where the menu couldn't be opened after removing all recipes.

Fixed an error causing the Mimic to display secret recipes.

Fixed an issue where chefs' secret recipes couldn't be labeled correctly.

Fixed an issue where the Fire Dancer's popularity bonus could persist until the next day.

Fixed an issue where the Apprentice Chef's recipe learning time was one day too long.

Fixed incorrect buff display for the Bard.

Increased the prices for all activities.

Fixed an issue where the Vine monster Manipulator allowed the bartender to infinitely obtain Vine monster Blood.

Fixed a skill error when the Vine monster was at maximum Favor.

Fixed an issue where recruitment coupons couldn't be used to hire financial staff.

Glutton now requires another server to be on duty before he can start his shift.

The Cloaked Figure can no longer use the "Reserve Equipment" skill on days the equipment shop is open.

Fixed an issue causing "High-Salary Recruitment" to infinitely increase wages.
[/olist]

notes.title: Minor updates & bug fixes
notes.notes:
This update addresses issues from the previous trial version and includes the following optimizations:
[olist]
Removed the debuff restriction during tavern upgrade evaluations.

Adjusted the guild privilege "High Tips":

Old: Extra 500 gold

New: Extra 100% gold

Reworked the guild privilege "Tavern Specialty":

Now, if the menu offers only one type of food or drink, its price increases by 50%.

Reduced the price cut from "Yellow Scorpion Sanction" (anti-price war) from 50% to 20%.

Reworked the item "Fully Booked Day":

Now increases the chance of perfect orders by 30% for the day.

Fixed: Receiving disliked gifts no longer reduces affection after maxing out relationships.

Fixed: Unable to close the tavern when no tasks were available.

Fixed: Upgrading equipment would upgrade all identical equipment simultaneously.

Fixed: Display error when Vine Demon equipment was assigned to drinks.

Fixed: Event host failed to trigger consecutive two-day event effects.

Fixed: Quartermaster could infinitely sell recipes.

Fixed: Unable to equip upgraded gear to employees in the warehouse.

Fixed: Upgrading equipment at max merchant affection would generate duplicate new gear.

Fixed: "High Recruitment" did not correctly increase wages for mimics.

Standardized all tooltip descriptions related to tips.

Fixed: Recipe stat changes sometimes failed to apply effects properly.

Adjusted: The equipment store button now only appears on Wednesdays.
[/olist]

notes.title: Medium-Sized Update
notes.notes:
Update Highlights:
This update brings significant changes to the Tavern Assessment System, enhances staff and items, and refreshes UI/music.
[hr][/hr]
📜 Detailed Patch Notes:
[olist]
New Dynamic Challenge System

Tavern assessments now apply 1 random restriction (e.g., limited staff/tables).

Guild Interface Overhaul

Completely redesigned Guild UI for better clarity.

New Soundtrack

Added exclusive BGM during assessments.

Rebalanced Guild Bond Items

Effect: Permanently boosts a recipe’s price by 100/200/400 gold (tier-based).

Item Rarity Adjustment

Sailor’s Brown Ale downgraded to Common (new price: 400g).

Merchant Skill Rework

"Today’s Special": Now reduces refresh cost & selling price by 60%.

Harvest Day Buff

Perfect dish chance ▲ from 10% → 30%.

Premium Drink Adjustment

Misty Way Pale price ▲ +500g.

New Hire Bonus (Carpenter Apprentice)

Immediately grants 1 Hardwood Long Table upon recruitment.
[/olist]

notes.title: Minor updates & bug fixes
notes.notes:

Luminous crystal stick

Devil's Music Sheet

notes.title: Minor updates & bug fixes
notes.notes:
This update focuses on further refining the demo experience. Here are the changes:


[olist]
Guild privileges and Yellow Scorpion sanctions can now be temporarily suspended, allowing players to review other information before making decisions.

Notifications in the top-right corner are now clickable and will redirect to their relevant pages.

Employee profiles now correctly display explanations for each attribute’s effects.

Fixed an issue where Stamped Wine List could generate empty orders.

Kitchen sabotage sanctions will now automatically force the second chef to take a break.

Flooded Cellar has been properly fixed (no more surprises!).

Fixed a bug preventing special employee mission from being completed.

Fixed incorrect popularity display after kitchen sabotage.

Adjusted special ingredient purchases to correct quantity errors.

Fixed an issue where reaching 100 Affection points wouldn’t trigger its intended effect.

Patched an exploit allowing unrestricted waiter recruitment after the first hire.
[/olist]
Balance Adjustments:
    12. Apostle of Lamo’s Skill III bonus reduced from 5% → 2%.
    13. Veteran Bartender’s multiplier decreased from 3× → 2×.
    14. Lowered the base price of Downfall aristocrat’s Aged Wine.
    15. Ice Sky Spoon upgraded to fancy-tier, while Bar Water Jug is now normal-tier.
    16. Adjusted the Dragon Arena butcher’s starting menu.
    17. Master Craft’s bonus increased from 0.1% → 0.3%.

notes.title: Minor updates & bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This is our first update after the Steam Next Fest, aimed at improving the demo experience, including visual effects and balancing guild privileges. We’ll continue developing the full version and will also give the UI a major overhaul soon!



Here’s what’s new in this update:
[olist]
Adjusted the feedback effect of function icons on the main interface.

Updated the sound effect and text size for customer payments—the more they pay, the more noticeable the effect.

Simplified the brewery interface for better clarity.

Increased the price of Signature light meal from 400 to 500.

Winery Support rewards from 6 barrels to 9 barrels.

Reworked Angel Investment—now grants 200 units of all rare ingredients.

Raised the price of Children’s Playground from 200 to 400.

Increased the Popularity bonus from Popular taste from 25% to 40%.

Adjusted Veteran Bartender’s cost multiplier from 1x to 3x the production count.

Baiying Secret’s price increase per bottle sold raised from 8 to 20.

Improved Crowd wisdom’s employee bonus from 10% to 20%.
[/olist]

notes.title: Small Update & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
**Thank you so much for all the feedback you've provided over the past two days!** I’ll address these issues as quickly as possible to improve the gaming experience. 



For now, I’ll focus on fixing bugs and more critical problems. Once the game stabilizes, I’ll start working on larger content adjustments to make it even more fun! 



### **Here are the changes in this update:** 



1. Flooding the cellar will now automatically reduce the number of barrels to a maximum of 3. 

2. Manually removing barrels now prioritizes empty ones first. 

3. Fixed a discrepancy between the required bribe amount and the displayed text for Masked. 

4. Fixed a mismatch between the repayment amount and the dialogue text for Baiying Teacher. 

5. Removed the "Refresh Tasks" feature. 

6. Fixed an issue where dismissed employees still appeared in dialogues. 

7. Fixed an issue where dismissed employees’ equipment was not unequipped. 

8. Fixed an issue where gift-giving didn’t complete the intended task. 

9. Advanced employee training tasks now accept **either "Liked" or "Loved" gifts** (previously only "Loved"). 

10. Employees threatened with Yellow Scorpion sanctions will now receive a warning. 

11. Fixed incorrect display text for "Position Full" reminders. 

12. Baiying Teacher can no longer be dismissed via employee threats. 

13. Fixed an issue where pressing the spacebar accidentally advanced to the next day. 

14. Fixed duplicate employees appearing in the chat interface. 

15. Fixed an exploit allowing infinite equipment farming from Masked. 

16. High-tier quests no longer reward Guild Privileges.
